reason: The 'no effect' conclusion rests on an unjustified north-only subsample (N=684) plus trimming. With the same controls, the full sample gives about 0.80 (SE 0.24, p<0.001) and the south gives about 1.8 (p<0.001). A non-significant estimate in one region, with a CI that includes sizable positive effects, is not evidence of no effect.
